key_decisions.rationale: Preserves anger and grief together, followed by command and restoration.
key_decisions.before: Looking around at them with anger and deeply grieved at the hardness of their hearts, Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
key_decisions.after: He looked around at them in anger, grieved by their hardened hearts. He told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And looking around at them with anger, grieved at the hardness of their heart, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.

key_decisions.before: When those close to him heard about it, they went out to restrain him, because they were saying, “He is out of his mind.”
key_decisions.after: When his family heard, they went out to take charge of him, for they were saying, “He is out of his mind.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And hearing it, those beside him went out to seize him, for they were saying, “He is out of his mind.”
